classifications.rationale: The President directs executive-branch procedures for acquiring and using federal space, prescribing priorities and factors for later administrative consideration rather than presently changing legal rights or dictating a specific legal outcome.
classifications.evidence: Procedures for meeting space needs in urban areas shall give serious consideration to the impact a site selection will have

classifications.rationale: The provision prescribes a management consideration for later federal site-selection and space-assignment decisions; it does not itself select a site or assign space.
classifications.evidence: Site selection and space assignments shall take into account the management needs for consolidation of agencies or activities

classifications.rationale: The Administrator must develop programs, issue implementation standards, manage federal space, conduct surveys, and submit plans, but the segment does not dictate a specified legally consequential result.
classifications.evidence: The Administrator of General Services shall develop programs to implement the policies of this Order

classifications.rationale: The segment assigns internal information-sharing, consultation, coordination, notice, and impact-assessment responsibilities governing how the Administrator later makes discretionary facilities decisions.
classifications.evidence: Coordinate proposed programs and plans for facilities and space with the Director of the Office of Management and Budget.

classifications.rationale: Executive-agency heads are directed to cooperate in implementation and manage their use of government space economically, an internal administrative mandate.
classifications.evidence: The heads of Executive agencies shall cooperate with the Administrator in implementing the policies of this Order

classifications.rationale: The segment imposes internal notice and compliance duties and revokes an earlier executive order; under the codebook, these are executive housekeeping and administrative-governance measures rather than substantive self-executing legal consequences.
classifications.evidence: Executive Order No. 11512 of February 27, 1970, is revoked.
